spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 1,288.0 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow of 4,237M minus capital spending of 2,949M per CEG/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260224_rpt20251231_acc0001868275_26_000032.htm and CEG/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json field normalized_owner_earnings_m). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at 2026-09-30 resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (-3.23 USD per share vs 28.53 base per contract_hash d11b5bbf). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-09-30) resolved -276.0 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm, confirming that heavy capital spending can push TTM owner earnings far below the annual FY2025 anchor during integration and restart cycles. Target Q3 FY2026 is not observable at registration (2026-09-02); expected 10-Q filing ~2026-11-07 per prior-year cadence (2025 Q3 10-Q filed 2025-11-07). Calpine acquisition closing and Crane restart capex keep TTM volatility structurally elevated versus the annual anchor.
